before: A composition over a selection set in another face than the text on both sides of it erased the selection and dropped the composed text: Chromium wrote that text into its own copy of the adjacent span, and the readback read each model range once.
after: The readback reads a span that the browser added during the composition, beside a span with the same range, as text the browser wrote there. The composition-start snapshot identifies the added span, so a range that layout paints more than once still contributes once.
reason: The composed text still reaches the document through the existing composition readback lane, as the same tree operations as typing over a selection. Shared nodes, offsets, operation shapes, and serialization are unchanged.
